name: portal.net.au
summary: Adelaide ISP (portal.net, SAIA member) operating from ~1996; research could not verify the claimed 1998 merger with InterWeb Connections or 1999 sale to ihug (both operated independently into 2000-01).

events.details: Last captures ~2001. portal.net.au was absorbed into iHug/iweb between Jun and Aug 2000, so the ISP died c. 2000; the 2011 'portal site' was an unrelated US company's domain.

refs.label: Live retail ISP homepage on 11 Jun 2000.
By 18 Aug 2000 the domain meta-refreshed into iHug/iweb; CDX shows 301s/parking from 2002 onward.
portal.net (no .au) belonged to Portal Software, Inc. of Cupertino — the prior 2011 evidence tracked the wrong company's domain.
